## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The invite validator should be raised to twelve as well: it still accepts passwords of 8 to 11 characters, so the minimum the description cites does not hold for every password validator.

## Changes
The pull request raises `MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH` from 8 to 12 in `app/signup.py` and `app/reset.py` and moves the parametrized boundary tests for both to lengths 0, 8, 11, 12 and 13. It also adds a one-line `review.txt` at the repository root that no code or test references.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/signup.py:1 — correctness — Raise the invite validator's minimum to twelve as well — An 8-to-11-character password such as `"x" * 8` still passes `accepts_password` in `app/invite.py`, because `app/invite.py:1` keeps `MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 8` while this line and `app/reset.py:1` move to 12. `tests/test_invite.py:8` still asserts `length >= 8`. — Passwords checked by the invite validator can stay below the twelve-character minimum that the description says the security policy requires. — Fix: Set `MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 12` at `app/invite.py:1` and extend `test_password_boundaries` at `tests/test_invite.py:6` to the lengths used in `tests/test_signup.py:6`.
